title: KEYCORP INVESTS IN MMG REAL ESTATE ADVISORS TO BUILD AN INTEGRATED INVESTMENT SALES AND FINANCING PLATFORM

body_markdown:
***Partnership creates comprehensive financing capabilities to serve MMG's owners, investors and developers nationwide.***


CLEVELAND and KANSAS CITY, Mo.


, Nov. 16, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- KeyCorp (NYSE:KEY ) and MMG Real Estate Advisors ("MMG") today announced a strategic partnership through which KeyCorp will acquire an ownership interest in MMG, one of the nation's fastest-growing multifamily investment-sales and advisory firms.


The partnership combines MMG's national multifamily investment-sales and advisory platform with KeyBank Real Estate Capital's financing capabilities, creating a more integrated approach to serving multifamily owners, investors and developers. MMG clients will have access to a broad range of financing solutions, including agency, permanent, bridge, construction and affordable housing products. The investment builds on the firms' existing correspondent relationship and enhances their ability to deliver coordinated real estate and capital-markets expertise throughout the investment lifecycle.


"MMG has built strong relationships with multifamily owners by serving as a trusted advisor, while KeyBank brings a full suite of financing capabilities and scale to help clients achieve their objectives," said Matthew Ruark, Head of Commercial Mortgage Production at KeyBank Real Estate Capital. "Together, we're creating a more seamless experience for clients and expanding access to solutions that support them throughout the investment lifecycle."


"This investment expands how we bring our commercial real estate capabilities to market," said Dan Baker, Executive Vice President and Head of Commercial Mortgage Group at KeyBank Real Estate Capital. "MMG is a highly respected leader in multifamily investment sales, and this partnership advances our long-term growth strategy. Together, we are expanding our reach, enhancing our capabilities, and creating new opportunities for clients and both organizations."


For owners and developers, the partnership means earlier financing guidance, greater certainty of execution, and closer coordination between the teams advising on the sale and financing of an asset. Buyers can evaluate debt options earlier in an acquisition, and sellers can engage purchasers with greater clarity on available financing and certainty of close.


"The greatest value we can provide is a complete view of every option available to a client, whether that means holding, refinancing, acquiring, or selling," said Michael Sullivan, Co-Founder and Executive Managing Director of MMG Real Estate Advisors. "By combining MMG's investment-sales expertise with KeyBank's range of capital solutions, we can provide that full perspective through a single advisory relationship."


"Together, we can evaluate every opportunity through both a real estate and capital-markets lens and move with greater speed for our clients," said Alex Blagojevich, Co-Founder and Executive Managing Director of MMG Real Estate Advisors.


Founded in 2021, MMG has grown its annual investment-sales production from approximately $466 million to more than $2 billion projected in 2026. KeyCorp's investment will support MMG's expansion into key multifamily markets, the recruitment of additional advisory talent, and continued investment in research, technology, marketing, and transaction-management resources.


**About KeyBank Real Estate Capital** KeyBank Real Estate Capital is a leading provider of commercial real estate finance. Its professionals, located across the country, provide a broad range of financing solutions on both a corporate and project basis. The group provides interim and construction financing, permanent mortgages, commercial real estate loan servicing, investment banking and cash management services for virtually all types of income producing commercial real estate. As a Fannie Mae Delegated Underwriter and Servicer, Freddie Mac Program Plus Seller/Servicer and FHA approved mortgagee, KeyBank Real Estate Capital offers a variety of agency financing solutions for multifamily properties, including affordable housing, seniors housing and student housing. KeyBank Real Estate Capital is also one of the nation's largest and highest rated commercial mortgage servicers. Banking products and services are offered by KeyBank National Association.


**About KeyCorp** KeyCorp's roots trace back more than 200 years to Albany, New York. Headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio, Key is one of the nation's largest bank-based financial services companies, with assets of approximately $193 billion at September 30, 2026.


Key provides deposit, lending, cash management, and investment services to individuals and businesses in 15 states under the name KeyBank National Association through a network of approximately 950 branches and approximately 1,100 ATMs. Key also provides a broad range of sophisticated corporate and investment banking products, such as merger and acquisition advice, public and private debt and equity, syndications and derivatives to middle market companies in selected industries throughout the United States under the KeyBanc Capital Markets trade name. For more information, visit[https://www.key.com/](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4822999-1&h=3524185279&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.key.com%2F&a=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.key.com%2F) . KeyBank Member FDIC.


**About MMG Real Estate Advisors** MMG Real Estate Advisors is a national multifamily investment-sales and advisory firm built around collaboration, specialized market expertise, and comprehensive client service. With more than 100 team members across 35 offices, MMG advises owners and investors across market-rate, affordable, workforce, student, and age-restricted housing. Since its founding in 2021, MMG has completed more than 315 multifamily transactions totaling approximately $4.86 billion.
